title: Check the premises before imposing the rules: an audit of fuzzy rule models on three student–AI interaction datasets (code, analysis plans, statistics)
description: Version 1.3.0. Code, time-stamped analysis plans (PREREG_*.md, each committed before its run) and statistics files for a three-check audit of fuzzy (TSK) rule models: antecedent signs within structural cells and within students, trivial baselines (structure, label persistence, student propensity), and cross-cohort transfer. Study 1 (StudyChat), Study 2 (TutorTrace), Study 3 (RECIPE4U). Revision R3 adds conditional logistic within-student checks, stability of the sign check over 200 splits, an alternative structure partition, noisy lagged labels, a support-scaled prior, output monotonicity of SC-TSK and SM-TSK, and a validation of the audit on simulated data. All analyses are exploratory. No third-party data are redistributed.
